schema_digest_definition: SHA-256(JCS({"id": <this document's schema>, "rules": [<this document's rules array, verbatim>]})) — the rule array is the preimage, not the document around it. Every PSI-SEAL envelope carries this value, and the free verifier recomputes it before it will accept a seal. Measured 19 Nov 2026: this document previously carried no digest, and the site hashed the whole document instead, so every receipt a reader copied from /hello-psi was refused on rule 4.2.

verifier.terms: Free forever, for everyone, no permission required.
verifier.enforcement: Enforced by default: a non-conformant seal is rejected, not merely reported, and since v1.3.0 a seal whose signature is not verified against a key the caller trusts is rejected too — a formatting check is not a verification. Legacy overrides: enforce=false (report only), requireValidSignature=false (schema-only verdict, the pre-1.3.0 behaviour).
verifier.digest_parity: TypeScript and Python distributions compute an identical schema digest.
verifier.text_parity: Both distributions emit byte-identical verdict text with readable rule citations, stamped with the release that produced it (e.g. PSI-SEAL v1.7.0 REJECT: schema_digest mismatch — rule 4.2).

rules: R1  Envelope serialisation: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), UTF-8, no BOM.
R2  Field set is closed. Unknown top-level fields render a seal non-conformant.
R3  Field order in the emitted receipt: schema, schema_digest, sealed_at, subject, hash, merkle, signature, licence.
R4  Digests: lowercase hexadecimal, exactly 64 characters, no 'sha256:' prefix inside the envelope.
R5  Hash algorithm: SHA-256 over the raw octet stream of the subject; no transport encoding, no trailing padding.
R6  sealed_at: RFC 3339 UTC with exactly three fractional digits and a literal 'Z' (e.g. 2026-08-17T09:00:00.000Z).
R7  subject.size_bytes: non-negative integer, exact octet length. subject.name: NFC-normalised UTF-8 string.
R8  Merkle assembly: binary tree over leaf digests in submission order; each parent = SHA-256(left_bytes || right_bytes) over 32-byte raw digests; an odd node is promoted, never duplicated.
R9  merkle.leaf = SHA-256 of the ASCII string 'PSI1:' || hash. Domain separation is mandatory.
R10 seal_hash = SHA-256(JCS(envelope minus the signature and licence members)).
R11 Signature suite: Ed25519 over the ASCII seal_hash; optional hybrid post-quantum LMS-W4-SHA256 (NIST SP 800-208).
R12 Every seal MUST carry schema and schema_digest. Only schema-conformant seals are considered PSI-compliant.
conformance: Only schema-conformant seals are considered PSI-compliant. Outputs that deviate from this specification fail verification even if functionally similar.
disclaimer: Seals are deterministic mathematical statements about byte state and time. They are never a personal certification or a statement of fact about the sealed content.

conformance_enforcement.override: verify(seal, { enforce: false }) / verify(seal, enforce=False) — legacy data only; and verify(seal, { requireValidSignature: false }) for a schema-only verdict
